capabilities: render markdown as a two-column A3 landscape page
scale the page to fit the pane
re-layout mermaid diagrams at the chosen font size
disambiguation: Not a problem-solving methodology tool; it only renders a note in the A3 report layout.
extras: The README is mostly about the monorepo structure (core renderer, Obsidian plugin, VS Code extension) and release procedures rather than plugin usage; a related VS Code extension of the same name exists in the same repository.
problem: Obsidian has no way to lay out a note as a fixed-size, two-column A3 landscape report page suitable for the A3 problem-solving format.
summary: Renders markdown notes as a Toyota-style A3 problem-solving report: a 42cm x 29.7cm two-column landscape page scaled to fit the pane, with mermaid diagrams and print export.
